BUYER BROKER AGREEMENT

This Buyer Broker Agreement is entered into as of July 6, 2026 between Hollis & Wray Realty, Inc. ("Broker") and Sam Whitaker ("Buyer").

1. Appointment. Buyer retains Broker in connection with Buyer's search for a home.

2. Compensation. Broker's compensation will be whatever amount the seller or the listing broker offers to pay.

3. Cooperation. Buyer will tell Broker about any home Buyer becomes interested in.

4. Governing Law. This Agreement is governed by the laws of the State of Georgia.

HOLLIS & WRAY REALTY, INC.

By: ______________________
Name: Paula Wray
Title: Managing Broker

BUYER

Sam Whitaker
